in_sanskrit.name: Idrish
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Ruler of the Sea
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Idrish एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Idrish is a Hindu name with an uncertain origin. It is believed to be a variant of Idris, an Arabic name meaning 'ruler' or 'he who is followed'. In Hindu mythology, Idrish is the name of a demigod associated with the sea. He is said to possess the power to control the tides and protect sailors from storms and pirates.
